newsitem.title: USA: Grill Concepts opens newest restaurant.
newsitem.headline: Grill Concepts opens newest restaurant.

text.p: Grill Concepts Inc, a restaurant chain operator, on Wednesday said it has opened its eighth and newest Daily Grill restaurant, located at the Los Angeles International Airport.
The new facility is expected to gross in excess of $6.5 million annually. Through the nine months ended Sept. 29, 1996, Grill Concept generated about $16.5 million in revenue.

Grill Concepts is partnered in the restaurant with CA One Services Inc, an airport food service company. Under their agreement, Grill Concepts receives a split of profits and a fee payment equal to four percent of annual sales.
